---
name: House Cleaning
about: Propose a maintenance, refactoring, or cleanup task
title: "[Housekeeping] "
labels: maintenance
assignees: ""

---

**What needs cleaning up?**

A clear and concise description of the code, dependency, documentation, or configuration that needs attention.

**Type of task**

- [ ] Refactoring (code structure, naming, dead code removal)
- [ ] Dependency update (Vue, Vite, Tauri, npm packages)
- [ ] Documentation (README, comments, contributing docs)
- [ ] Tooling / CI (workflows, linting, Docker setup)
- [ ] Tests (add, fix, or improve coverage)
- [ ] Other

**Affected files / components**

List the relevant files, components, or modules (e.g. `src/components/...`).

**Why is this needed?**

What problem does the current state cause? (technical debt, deprecation warnings, security advisories, confusing structure, etc.)

**Proposed approach**

Outline how this could be resolved. Note any breaking changes or side effects.

**Additional context**

Links to related issues/PRs, deprecation notices, or upstream changelogs.
